actions.name: irsend
actions.description: Queue a known IR command for transmission.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: A known command name such as POWER, or its hexadecimal code.

actions.name: ac_manual_sync
actions.description: Synchronize Adler's AC belief with the physical unit without transmitting IR.

actions.name: ac_sleep
actions.description: Turn the AC off after a number of minutes; zero cancels the timer.

actions.name: ac_morning_off
actions.description: Run the morning shutdown immediately, optionally overriding sleep-in.

sensors.name: irrecv
sensors.description: Name of the last IR command received.

sensors.name: door
sensors.description: Door-open state supplied by another NightMare device.

sensors.name: ac_status
sensors.description: Complete AC controller state as a compatibility JSON document.

sensors.name: ac_state
sensors.description: Controller state: unknown, off/on, target-controlled, or door-paused.

sensors.name: ac_known
sensors.description: Whether Adler's AC belief has been synchronized with the physical unit.

sensors.name: ac_sleep_deadline
sensors.description: Sleep shutdown Unix timestamp, or zero if inactive or wall time is unavailable.

states.name: ac_temperature
states.description: Temperature shown on the AC unit, 18-30 C.

states.name: ac_target
states.description: Thermostat target; a negative value disables thermostat control.

states.name: ac_sleep_in
states.description: Skip the normal morning shutdown once.
